_comment: Lens table for the PR review gate. The triage job chooses lens IDS ONLY;
this file decides what each one costs. Keeping model/effort/turns here and
not in the model's output means a reviewer cannot vote itself more compute.
max_turns: konyklabs/roadmap#16 measured the old gate's demand at 7-30 turns
with a cap of 30, so the tail failed. These caps sit well above observed
demand on purpose: a cap is a runaway backstop, not a budget.
